channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Matisse Thybulle | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Matisse Thybulle from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Austin Reaves on Matisse Thybulle, Ziaire Williams, Walker Kessler, Adou Thiero
item.description:
Lakers guard Austin Reaves on Wednesday:

“Trying to score on Matisse (Thybulle) and Ziaire (Williams), especially with Adou (Thiero) out there too, and then Walker (Kessler) on the back line is not easy.“I had to deal with that all day yesterday and today, and it's not fun.”

Austin Reaves on Matisse Thybulle, Ziaire Williams, Walker Kessler, Adou Thiero, Sep 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Jerami Grant, Matisse Thybulle
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Chauncey Billups:

“Everything I believe in as a coach is what [Grant and Thybulle] embody. They take coaching, they can both be good on the offensive side and the defensive side of the ball.”

Chauncey Billups on Jerami Grant, Matisse Thybulle, Jul 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Jalen McDaniels, Matisse Thybulle
item.description:
Daryl Morey on why he thinks Jalen McDaniels can hang in playoffs, vs. Thybulle:

“I mean, I think it's pretty straightforward. If you're making it harder for the team on offense, I think it makes it harder to keep you on the floor defensively.”

Daryl Morey on Jalen McDaniels, Matisse Thybulle, Feb 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @rich_hofmann.

item.title: Tobias Harris on Matisse Thybulle
item.description:
Sixers'Tobias Harris shared his message to Thybulle yesterday:

“Whatever is gonna happen, you're gonna be fine... If it’s here or elsewhere, you gotta be ready for your opportunity and moment. That’s my biggest advice ... you get an opportunity, just take advantage of it.”

Tobias Harris on Matisse Thybulle, Feb 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @JGrasso_.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Matisse Thybulle
item.description:
Lauren Rosen:Joel Embiid on @Matisse Thybulle's growth in the offseason:

“I’m so proud of [Matisse]. So far, you can tell he put in the work all summer. He’s been amazing. He’s made a lot of improvement, and that’s what we want.”

Joel Embiid on Matisse Thybulle, Sep 29, 2022. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Matisse Thybulle
item.description:
Doc Rivers on @Matisse Thybulle:

“He looks good. He’s running the floor, he does things Matisse does. Offensively…I’m very happy with him. He’s a far better cutter and picker. He works on [his shot], he puts the time into it. I believe he’ll become a better shooter each year.”

Doc Rivers on Matisse Thybulle, Oct 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris, Matisse Thybulle, Ben Simmons
item.description:
#Sixers coachDoc Rivers on if Ben Simmons addressed the team:

“We just introduced like we always do when a new guy comes back or the old guys comes back. We jokingly did it. We did it with Tobias as well, because he's been on vacation and Matisse as well. But as I told you before, the players pretty much welcome guys back.”

Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris, Matisse Thybulle, Ben Simmons, Oct 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @PompeyOnSixers.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Matisse Thybulle
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Doc Rivers on Matisse Thybulle:

“His ability to close out reminds me a lot of Deion Sanders.”

Doc Rivers on Matisse Thybulle, Apr 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Tobias Harris, Joel Embiid, Ben Simmons, Matisse Thybulle, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
“Well, I don’t have all of them because they’re hard to get. But I’ve got Joel (Embiid), I’ve got Ben (Simmons), I’ve got Tobias (Harris), I’ve got (Tyrese) Maxey, I’ve got (Matisse) Thybulle. “Some of the players need to complain and say, ‘Where are my highlights?’”

Daryl Morey on Tobias Harris, Joel Embiid, Ben Simmons, Matisse Thybulle, Tyrese Maxey, Mar 13, 2021. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Brett Brown on Matisse Thybulle
item.description:
Jon Johnson:Brown on Matisse Thybulle:

“He leads our team in deflections. He's in the top three in steals in the times we've practice. He's just so disruptive.”

Brett Brown on Matisse Thybulle, Jul 16, 2020. Source: Twitter @jonjohnsonwip.
